name: Prince Zeus
description: From an irresistibly fluffy 12-week-old kitten into a striking young male at 12 months and beyond, Prince Zeus has matured in a way that is impossible to overlook. His red silver shaded coat with white has become more defined with age, giving him a soft, luminous look that feels both distinctive and refined. Even as a youngster, he had a memorable expression and standout presence, and those qualities have only grown stronger over time. His development beautifully shows the transformation from a sweet, fluffy baby into a confident, eye-catching adult with real character.
